equivalence.name: parent components admitted
equivalence.scope: Declared Rust string-admission/result semantics under pinned std; not identical instruction count or elapsed time.
equivalence.proof: Let P be part == ".." and B be the disjunction of the other component refusals. If P, the final character is ASCII dot, hence part.ends_with([dot, space]) is true and B is true. If not P, removing the P disjunct changes nothing. Thus P OR B equals B for every valid str. Equality and ends_with use immutable built-in str and a fixed pattern, with no user callbacks or side effects. The original raw survivor is preserved, never credited as a kill.

followup_required: Run the declared overlapping-traversal-guards mutation. The redundant one-site deletion cannot discharge that fault class.
